Title: F-ADM-001 AC-01: CLI ingestion interface
Objective: Ingestion must be runnable via CLI with required args
Preconditions: Sample PDF file; node installed; DB access; embedding API credentials
Steps: 1) Run ingest CLI with file and metadata args; 2) Check exit code and run summary; 3) Query ingestion run record
Expected Result: CLI run completes with exit 0 and run summary; no UI required; run record created
DB Validation: SELECT id, file_name, status FROM ingestion_runs WHERE file_name ILIKE '%sample.pdf%';

Title: F-ADM-001 AC-02: Chunking, tagging & embedding
Objective: Pipeline performs chunking (500 token/50 overlap), metadata tagging, embedding and pgvector storage
Preconditions: Sample PDF; embedding API reachable; pgvector extension enabled
Steps: 1) Run ingest CLI; 2) Inspect produced chunk records and embeddings; 3) Verify metadata tags present
Expected Result: Chunks created with expected size/overlap; embeddings persisted in vector store; metadata includes board/subject/chapter
DB Validation: SELECT count(*) FROM content_chunks WHERE run_id = '<run_id>' AND token_count <= 600;
API Validation: Query pgvector table for vectors for run_id

Title: F-ADM-001 AC-03: Idempotent ingestion
Objective: Re-running ingestion with same metadata must not create duplicate chunks; updates should be versioned
Preconditions: Existing ingestion run for same PDF and metadata
Steps: 1) Run ingest CLI twice with identical args; 2) Compare chunk counts and versions; 3) Verify previous chunks versioned or replaced
Expected Result: Second run should update or version existing chunks not create duplicates
DB Validation: SELECT chunk_id, version FROM content_chunks WHERE source_file = 'sample.pdf' ORDER BY version DESC;
Notes: Ensure no duplicate content in vector store

Title: F-ADM-001 AC-04: MVP seed content present
Objective: Seed curriculum for CBSE Grade 10 Math & Science must be present in DB
Steps: 1) Query existence of seed content for CBSE Grade 10 Math/Science; 2) Verify at least minimal chunks and concept mappings
Expected Result: Seed content exists for required boards/grades and subjects
DB Validation: SELECT count(*) FROM content_chunks WHERE board='CBSE' AND grade=10 AND subject IN ('Mathematics','Science');
Notes: Fail release if seed content missing

Title: F-ADM-001 AC-05: Ingestion run logging
Objective: Every ingest run writes summary to analytics/events with metrics
Steps: 1) Run ingest; 2) Query analytics events for run_id; 3) Validate metrics fields present
Expected Result: Analytics.events contains run summary with chunks_created, embeddings_generated, duration_ms
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='ingest_run' AND payload->>'file' ILIKE '%sample.pdf%';
Notes: Ensure errors field populated on failures

Title: F-ADM-001 AC-06: Taxonomy mapping enforced
Objective: Ingestion must map chunks to pre-seeded taxonomy and not auto-create concepts
Steps: 1) Run ingest referencing chapter codes; 2) Confirm chunk.concept_id not null and maps to taxonomy
Expected Result: Chunks reference existing concept IDs; no new concepts auto-created
DB Validation: SELECT chunk_id, concept_id FROM content_chunks WHERE run_id = '<run_id>' AND concept_id IS NOT NULL;

Title: F-ADM-001 AC-07: Failed chunk handling & retry
Objective: Failed chunks logged separately and retry mechanism available
Preconditions: Ingest run with intentionally malformed chunk or simulated embedding failure
Steps: 1) Run ingest to create a failed chunk; 2) Verify failed_chunks table contains ID; 3) Run retry script and confirm success
Expected Result: Failed chunk logged; retry processes and marks chunk completed
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM failed_chunks WHERE run_id = '<run_id>';
Notes: Verify retry idempotency and error details

Title: F-ADM-002 AC-01: Taxonomy seeded via SQL
Objective: Taxonomy levels seeded by SQL scripts (boards→subjects→chapters→topics→concepts)
Preconditions: Local dev DB; taxonomy SQL scripts present
Steps: 1) Run taxonomy seed script (dry-run then real); 2) Query taxonomy tables
Expected Result: Taxonomy tables populated with expected codes and hierarchy
DB Validation: SELECT count(*) FROM taxonomy_concepts WHERE board='CBSE' AND grade=10;

Title: F-ADM-002 AC-02: Concept metadata fields
Objective: Concepts must include bloom_level, prerequisite_concept_ids, commonly_confused_with_ids
Steps: 1) Inspect concept row schema; 2) Verify sample concept has required fields populated
Expected Result: Concept rows include bloom_level and prerequisite arrays
DB Validation: SELECT id, bloom_level, prerequisite_concept_ids FROM taxonomy_concepts WHERE id = '<concept_id>';

Title: F-ADM-002 AC-03: Versioned taxonomy changes
Objective: Taxonomy updates must be versioned with updated_at and updated_by
Steps: 1) Update a concept's irt_b or prerequisites; 2) Query history table
Expected Result: Change recorded in taxonomy_concept_history with old and new values
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM taxonomy_concept_history WHERE concept_id = '<concept_id>' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;

Title: F-ADM-002 AC-04: Content readiness gating
Objective: Subject/grade must be complete before enabling to students
Preconditions: Taxonomy and chunk ingestion for candidate subject
Steps: 1) Attempt to enable subject feature flag before full seeding; 2) Attempt after seeding
Expected Result: System blocks enable until taxonomy+chunks+questions criteria met
DB Validation: SELECT flag_value FROM feature_flags WHERE key = 'subject_enabled_CBSE_MATH_10';

Title: F-ADM-002 AC-05: Feature-flag control
Objective: Subject availability controlled by feature flag per board/subject/grade
Steps: 1) Toggle feature flag for CBSE-MATH-10 on; 2) Confirm students can access content when enabled
Expected Result: When enabled, students with access see content; when disabled, content hidden
DB Validation: SELECT value FROM feature_flags WHERE key='CBSE_MATH_10_enabled';

Title: F-ADM-003 AC-01: AI-generated question oversight
Objective: Questions are AI-generated by default; admin handles quarantined exceptions
Preconditions: Question bank exists with AI-generated source rows
Steps: 1) Query questions source='ai' and sample recent items; 2) Verify admin can view via Prisma
Expected Result: AI-generated questions present and flagged for review when needed
DB Validation: SELECT id, source, status FROM question_bank WHERE source='ai' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

Title: F-ADM-003 AC-02: Quarantine trigger
Objective: Question gets quarantined after 3 student flags
Preconditions: Question with id Q123; simulate 3 student flag events
Steps: 1) Insert 3 flag events for question id; 2) Query question status
Expected Result: Question.status='quarantined' and removed from serving
DB Validation: SELECT id, status, flag_count FROM question_bank WHERE id = '<question_id>';

Title: F-ADM-003 AC-03: Admin review via Prisma Studio
Objective: Admin reviews quarantined questions via query
Steps: 1) As admin, run query WHERE status='quarantined'; 2) Approve/reject a sample question
Expected Result: Approved questions return to active; rejected marked invalid
DB Validation: SELECT id, status, last_flagged_at FROM question_bank WHERE status='quarantined';
Notes: Record admin action in audit log

Title: F-ADM-003 AC-04: Manual seed bypass
Objective: Admin can seed manual questions tagged source='manual'
Preconditions: Seed script present and admin access
Steps: 1) Run seed script to insert manual question; 2) Verify question inserted with source='manual'
Expected Result: Question present with source='manual' and not subject to AI validation gates
DB Validation: SELECT id, source FROM question_bank WHERE source='manual' AND concept_id = '<concept_id>';
Notes: Manual seeds bypass AI gates as specified

Title: F-ADM-003 AC-05: IRT validation after responses
Objective: After 50 student responses, nightly job fits 3PL and promotes questions
Steps: 1) Ensure question has >=50 responses; 2) Run nightly job or simulate; 3) Verify validation status change
Expected Result: Question.validation_status='validated' and IRT params stored
DB Validation: SELECT id, response_count, validation_status FROM question_bank WHERE id = '<question_id>';

Title: F-ADM-003 AC-06: Weekly health report
Objective: Weekly automated health report generated and emailed to content admin
Steps: 1) Trigger weekly report job; 2) Verify report generation and email queue entry
Expected Result: Report created with questions-per-concept metrics and emailed
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM email_queue WHERE template='question_bank_health' AND created_at > now() - interval '2 days';

Title: F-ADM-004 AC-01: Schema & fields
Objective: Misconception records must include specified schema fields
Steps: 1) Query sample misconception record; 2) Verify diagnostic_signals and contrastive_example present
Expected Result: Misconception rows have required diagnostic fields populated
DB Validation: SELECT id, subject, diagnostic_signals FROM misconception_library WHERE subject='Mathematics' LIMIT 5;

Title: F-ADM-004 AC-02: Minimum misconceptions
Objective: MVP requires ≥20 misconceptions per subject
Steps: 1) Count misconceptions per subject; 2) Verify >=20 for Math and Science
Expected Result: Counts meet minimum requirement
DB Validation: SELECT subject, count(*) FROM misconception_library GROUP BY subject HAVING count(*) >= 20;
Notes: If missing, fail content readiness gate

Title: F-ADM-004 AC-03: Queue from escalations
Objective: New misconceptions from escalations queued for review
Steps: 1) Query escalations for uncategorised misconception candidates; 2) Verify admin review workflow
Expected Result: Queue contains candidate misconceptions for admin to review
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM escalations WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND reason = 'misconception_candidate';
Notes: Admin must add to library after review

Title: F-ADM-004 AC-04: Prevalence update job
Objective: Monthly analytics job updates prevalence_rate
Steps: 1) Run prevalence job; 2) Verify misconception.prevalence_rate updated
Expected Result: Prevalence_rate updated and stored
DB Validation: SELECT id, prevalence_rate FROM misconception_library WHERE subject='Mathematics' LIMIT 5;
Notes: Job must be idempotent and logged

Title: F-ADM-010 AC-01: Transcript storage
Objective: Every session transcript must be stored and queryable
Steps: 1) Complete a student session; 2) Query session_transcripts for session_id
Expected Result: Full transcript available with session_turns and roles
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM session_transcripts WHERE session_id = '<session_id>';
Notes: Ensure transcripts retained per retention policy

Title: F-ADM-010 AC-02: Daily sampling
Objective: Daily sample query returns random 10 sessions with AI turns
Preconditions: Session transcripts exist for previous day
Steps: 1) Run sample query; 2) Export 10 session transcripts for review
Expected Result: Returned sample includes 10 sessions with AI turns
DB Validation: SELECT session_id FROM session_transcripts WHERE date(created_at) = current_date - 1 ORDER BY random() LIMIT 10;

Title: F-ADM-010 AC-03: Quality flags
Objective: Admin can flag sessions with quality_flag values
Steps: 1) Flag a sampled session with 'hallucination'; 2) Verify flag persisted
Expected Result: Session flagged with quality_flag and visible to reviewers
DB Validation: SELECT session_id, quality_flag FROM session_quality_flags WHERE session_id = '<session_id>';

Title: F-ADM-010 AC-04: SLA for reviews
Objective: Safety concerns reviewed within 2 hours; other flags within 48 hours
Steps: 1) Create a safety flag event; 2) Verify escalation and resolution timestamps
Expected Result: Safety flags show resolved_at within SLA window
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM session_quality_flags WHERE flag='safety_concern' AND created_at > now() - interval '3 hours';

Title: F-ADM-010 AC-05: Negative example usage
Objective: Flagged sessions used as negative examples for prompt iteration
Preconditions: Flagged sessions processed into examples dataset
Steps: 1) Run export job for flagged sessions; 2) Verify export pipeline adds examples to prompt-rewrite queue
Expected Result: Export contains flagged turns and admin notes
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM prompt_iteration_examples WHERE source='flagged_session' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

Title: F-ADM-010 AC-06: Rating aggregation
Objective: Student session rating data aggregated weekly and reported
Steps: 1) Run weekly aggregation job; 2) Query aggregated metrics
Expected Result: Avg rating per subject and concept present and exported
DB Validation: SELECT subject, avg(rating) FROM session_ratings WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY subject;
Notes: Trigger content review on sustained low ratings

Title: F-ADM-011 AC-01: Escalation queue
Objective: Doubts escalated after 3 AI failures written to escalations table
Steps: 1) Create test doubt that triggers 3 failed resolution attempts; 2) Verify escalations row created
Expected Result: Escalation row created with doubt text, attempts, concept_id and anonymised student_id
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM escalations WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY escalated_at DESC LIMIT 10;

Title: F-ADM-011 AC-02: Weekly unresolved query
Objective: Admin queries unresolved escalations weekly
Steps: 1) Query escalations WHERE resolved_at IS NULL; 2) Export list for review
Expected Result: Unresolved escalations returned ordered by escalated_at
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM escalations WHERE resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY escalated_at;

Title: F-ADM-011 AC-03: Admin resolution actions
Objective: Admin resolution can update curriculum chunk, add misconception, or cache resolution
Steps: 1) Resolve a queued escalation and apply one of the actions; 2) Verify change persisted and student notified
Expected Result: Content updated or misconception added and resolution cached in doubt_kb
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM doubt_kb WHERE source_escalation_id = '<id>' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL;

Title: F-ADM-011 AC-04: Resolution metadata & notification
Objective: Escalated doubt marked with resolved_at and resolution_type; student notified
Steps: 1) Mark an escalation resolved; 2) Verify resolved_at, resolution_type and notification queued
Expected Result: Escalation has resolved_at and notification exists for student
DB Validation: SELECT resolved_at, resolution_type FROM escalations WHERE id = '<id>';
Notes: Verify notification content follows privacy rules

Title: F-ADM-011 AC-05: Trending topics alert
Objective: Trending escalations (>5 distinct students/week) triggers content priority alert
Steps: 1) Simulate >5 escalations for same concept from different students; 2) Verify alert created
Expected Result: Content priority alert created for the concept
DB Validation: SELECT concept_id, count(distinct student_hash) FROM escalations WHERE escalated_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY concept_id HAVING count(distinct student_hash) > 5;

Title: F-ADM-012 AC-01: Cost events recorded
Objective: Every LLM API call writes a cost event to analytics.events with required metadata
Steps: 1) Trigger a sample LLM call; 2) Query analytics.events for cost event
Expected Result: Analytics.events contains cost event with model, tokens, cost_usd
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='llm_cost' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 10;
Notes: Cost fields must be populated for every call

Title: F-ADM-012 AC-02: Daily cost report
Objective: Daily cost report aggregated by call_type, model, subject
Steps: 1) Run daily report job; 2) Verify report entries and sums
Expected Result: Daily report sums cost_usd grouped as required
DB Validation: SELECT call_type, model, SUM(cost_usd) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='llm_cost' AND occurred_at > now() - interval '1 day' GROUP BY call_type, model;
Notes: Report must be queryable in Neon console

Title: F-ADM-012 AC-03: Cost anomaly detection
Objective: If daily cost >1.5x rolling 7-day avg, admin alert sent
Steps: 1) Simulate a spike in cost events; 2) Run anomaly detection job; 3) Verify alert queued
Expected Result: Anomaly alert created and emailed to admin
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM alerts WHERE type='cost_anomaly' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 day';

Title: F-ADM-012 AC-04: Cost per session metric
Objective: Daily cost per session metric computed and alerted if outside range
Steps: 1) Compute daily SUM(cost_usd)/COUNT(sessions); 2) Verify metric within $0.15-$0.25
Expected Result: Metric computed and stored; alert generated if out of range
DB Validation: SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS day, SUM(cost_usd)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id),0) AS cost_per_session FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='llm_cost' GROUP BY day;

Title: F-ADM-012 AC-05: Cache hit-rate monitoring
Objective: Cache hit rate tracked (explanation_cache_hits / total_teach_calls) and target >55%
Steps: 1) Query cache metrics for last day; 2) Verify hit rate value
Expected Result: Cache hit rate reported and stored
DB Validation: SELECT (sum(explanation_cache_hits)::float / NULLIF(sum(total_teach_calls),0))*100 AS hit_pct FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='cache_metric' AND occurred_at > now() - interval '1 day';

Title: F-ADM-013 AC-01: Safety layer events
Objective: AI safety triggers write safety_event to analytics.events
Preconditions: Safety layer injection in session system prompt
Steps: 1) Trigger a safety condition in a session; 2) Verify safety_event logged
Expected Result: Safety_event present with trigger_type and offending_turn_id
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='safety_triggered' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20;
Notes: Safety events must be reviewed within SLA

Title: F-ADM-013 AC-02: Daily safety event queries
Objective: Admin queries safety events daily for review
Steps: 1) Run safety events query; 2) Export for review
Expected Result: Query returns recent safety events ordered by occurred_at
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type='safety_triggered' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100;

Title: F-ADM-013 AC-03: Low-groundedness flagging
Objective: Hallucination detection flags low_groundedness responses for admin review
Steps: 1) Identify responses with grounding_score below threshold; 2) Verify flagged set
Expected Result: Flagged responses present for review and follow-up
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM response_evaluations WHERE groundedness_score < 0.5 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

Title: F-ADM-013 AC-04: Curriculum remediation on hallucination
Objective: If hallucination found in curriculum explanation, admin can update chunk or suspend concept
Steps: 1) Flag content used in hallucination; 2) Update chunk or flip suspend flag; 3) Verify change
Expected Result: Chunk updated or feature-flag for concept set to suspended
DB Validation: SELECT * FROM content_chunks WHERE id = '<chunk_id>' AND status <> 'suspended';

Title: F-ADM-013 AC-05: Account suspension & reversal
Objective: Admin can suspend accounts for jailbreak attempts and reverse suspension
Steps: 1) Suspend test account; 2) Verify access blocked and audit log written; 3) Re-enable account and verify restored access
Expected Result: Account status toggled and audit recorded; suspension reversible
DB Validation: SELECT id, status FROM users WHERE id = '<student_id>' AND status IN ('active','suspended');
Notes: Audit log must include reason and admin_id
